s1.syndrome_frame: cutaneous vascular lesion with telangiectasias in a patient with metastatic cancer
salient_findings: single, well-defined, blanchable bright red plaque on the lower right lateral shin
discrete clusters of small-caliber vessels on histopathological analysis
KDR (VEGFR2) c.C2312G, p.T771R somatic mutation identified on genetic analysis
key_facts: patient is a man in his 40s
patient has stage IV KRAS wild-type rectal adenocarcinoma
patient has pulmonary and liver metastases
patient has undergone radiation therapy and multiple chemotherapy cycles
lesion developed in early January 2015
lesion is not associated with pain or pruritus
lesion is 4 cm in diameter
histopathological analysis shows normal epidermis
genetic analysis was performed using paired whole-exome sequencing of affected tissue and patient's blood
